understanding.goal_understanding: Solve each KA59 level by getting every goal tile marked with a '+' to be occupied by a movable/selectable piece at the same time; once all goals are covered simultaneously the level reports WIN, and completing all levels wins the run within the step budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: A single piece is "selected" at a time. Arrow actions (MOVE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) attempt to move the selected piece by one grid cell; if the destination is a wall/obstacle, out of bounds, or otherwise invalid, the piece does not move and the step is still consumed. CLICK [x,y] attempts to move the currently selected piece to the clicked tile/position (effectively a direct reposition to the target when allowed by the puzzle's movement rules); if the target is blocked/invalid the piece remains in place. Winning requires positioning pieces onto the '+' goal tiles simultaneously before steps run out.
